Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar is 18th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or equivalent in Electrical/Electronics/Physics/Materials Science discipline, or an M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent in the same disciplines with a minimum of 02 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist post as per the official notification released by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar typically involves a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPON/10455/Advt0302.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of IIT Gandhinagar is also provided.
